content.short: IntentX is an intent-based perpetual futures DEX on Base and Mantle offering high leverage for over 260 pairs.
content.description: IntentX is a next-generation decentralized perpetual exchange that utilizes a cutting-edge intent-based architecture for professional-grade trading. Operating on Base and Mantle, the platform offers over 260 trading pairs with up to 60x leverage. Unlike traditional order books, IntentX relys on bilateral trade agreements, ensuring deep liquidity and minimal slippage. On Mantle, it utilizes USDe as collateral, allowing traders to earn rewards while maintaining active positions. By combining intent-based speed with on-chain security, IntentX is redefining decentralized derivatives.
